title: Item:Sentient Jewel of the Furious
wikitext:
{{Consumable
  | picdesc     = Sentient Jewel of the Furious.png
  | acquired    = Lavinia Lanston
  | location    = Ravenloft Blood on the Vine Tavern
  | turnin      = Epic Saga Reward
  | minlevel    = 20
  | bind        = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}
  | effect      = A jewel that holds [[Sentient Weapon|sentient power]].
  | cost        = 500 pp
  | weight      = 0.01 lbs
  | stack       = <!-- Stack size for this consumable - default 100 -->
  | description = A jewel that holds sentient power. Click on the Sentient Item button on the right side of the inventory panel (or drag a weapon to that slot) to open the sentient Item panel.
  | notes       = Voiced by [[Alexander Brandon]].
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): "YES!"
:* On first equip
:: (Say): "Legends will be told of our deeds!"
:* Random in combat
:: (Say): "Smash them. Smash them all!"
:: (Say): "Counting our kills calms my nerves." 
:: (Say): "Bash 'em up, bash 'em in. To leave 'em alive would be a sin."
:* On unequiping
:: (Say): "What good am I to you in a backpack?"
:* On re-equipping or logging in
:: (Say): "I've been on many great adventures. But the best is yet to come!"
:* On Quest aquisition
:: (Say): "Enough talking. Let's get back to the part where we hurt things."
:* On Quest completion
:: (Say): "Enough talking. Let's get back to the part where we hurt things."
:* On Quest turn-in
:: (Say): "Savor our victory. Celebrate our triumph. Glory in our carnage!"
:* On feeding
:: (Say): "The more you feed me, the more I hunger for carnage and glory!"
:* On successful search
:: (Say): "Yes! You have the eyes of an eagle."
:* On looting a chest
:: (Say): "Yes, yes. Claim the spoils of victory, then let's move on. There are more heads to bash. I can feel it!"
:: (Say): "You collect our riches! I'll take a moment to calm myself for the next fight."
:* On picking up a collectible
:: (Say): " I don't see how this will help us bash heads, but fine."
:* On weapon durability loss:
:: (Say): "I'm supposed to dish out pain, not receive it!"
:: (Say): "Don't make me angry. I don't like me when I'm angry."
:* On player death
:: (Say): "I am going to take a moment. You didn't mean to damage me. We'll just pick ourselves up... and move on."
:: (Say): "It can't end like this! We were meant to conquer!"
:: (Say): "I know you didn't mean to get killed. I know you didn't mean to drop me. But next time, BE CAREFUL!"
:* On resting
:: (Say): "Don't rest too long. Those heads won't bash themselves."
}}
